title: Print Newline Escape Sequence

sampleTestCases.explanation: Input '' produces expected output '' following problem rules.

solution.notes: Ensure edge case and standard I/O format handling.
solution.editorial: To print the literal escape sequence '\n' rather than a newline character, escape the backslash character as '\\n'.

hints: A single backslash starts an escape sequence.
To output a literal backslash, double it: '\\'.
learningObjectives: Learn how backslash characters are escaped in programming languages.
Distinguish between control characters (newline) and literal representations.
Master escape sequences in string literals.
